sources.author: Farahi, Hamiduddin (Ḥamīd al-Dīn al-Farāhī)
sources.name: Mufradat al-Qur'an; Niẓām al-Qur'an wa-taʾwīl al-furqān bi-l-furqān
sources.note: Farahi's writings on Qur'anic vocabulary and discourse coherence, left unfinished at his death in 1930 and completed/edited posthumously by his students. No independently verifiable modern edition/publisher/page reference is asserted here; see the mir-coherence-1986 entry for independent secondary corroboration of these works' foundational role.

sources.author: Mir, Mustansir
sources.name: Coherence in the Qur'an: A Study of Islahi's Concept of Nazm in Tadabbur-i Qur'an
sources.note: Independent scholarly monograph (125 pp., paperback) establishing Farahi's Mufradat al-Qur'an and Niẓām al-Qur'an as the direct conceptual foundation of Islahi's nazm-based method — the second, independent source used to move the farahi-primary claim from Pending to Verified. Mir also wrote the foreword to Khan's 2013 An Exercise (see khan-exercise-2013).
